title: 10. Faculty Course Roster
description: Match university courses with their assigned teaching professor.
objective: Select Courses.title, Courses.code, and Professors.name by joining Courses with Professors on professor_id.
targetQuery: SELECT Courses.title, Courses.code, Professors.name FROM Courses JOIN Professors ON Courses.professor_id = Professors.id;
hint: Join Courses with Professors ON Courses.professor_id = Professors.id
